text:
The court will most likely uphold the statute: under *Anderson-Burdick* balancing, the 20% party threshold is an objective, neutral line, the 180-day circulation period matches the deadline parties face, and comparable signature requirements have been upheld (*Jenness v. Fortson*, 5%; *Storer v. Brown*). The shared note that all ballot-access restrictions are automatically invalid is wrong, because the Court applies a sliding-scale balancing test rather than automatic invalidation. The 7% figure is the most vulnerable element, since it exceeds the 5% upheld in *Jenness*.

CONFIDENCE: 65
